verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 is a hardware platform with a management and software stack (BMC with Redfish/IPMI, DGX OS, NIM/NeMo), so an official MCP server for agents is a plausible capability and the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no official MCP server. The llms.txt documentation index for AI user agents is an adjacent docs feature, not an MCP server, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
